## Our Approach

Two complementary pillars, one integrated approach, and a portfolio of research and applied projects.

```{=html}
<section class="lab-framework" aria-label="AI Governance Lab framework">
  <div class="framework-root"><strong>AI Governance Lab</strong><span>Independent research &amp; technology initiative</span></div>
  <div class="framework-fork" aria-hidden="true"><i></i></div>
  <div class="framework-pair">
    <div class="framework-pillar framework-plum"><small>PILLAR 1</small><h3>Governance of AI</h3><p>How AI should be evaluated, regulated and governed.</p></div>
    <div class="framework-pillar framework-sage"><small>PILLAR 2</small><h3>AI for Governance</h3><p>How AI can improve governance and public policy.</p></div>
  </div>
  <div class="framework-join" aria-hidden="true"><i></i></div>
  <div class="framework-process"><small>INTEGRATED APPROACH</small><h3>Design → Develop → Evaluate</h3><p>Understand institutional challenges, build AI solutions and assess their real-world impact.</p><p class="framework-note">Projects may focus on one stage or span the full lifecycle.</p></div>
  <div class="framework-stem" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="framework-projects"><h3>Projects</h3><div class="framework-pair"><div class="framework-type"><strong>Research projects</strong><p>Empirical studies, methodologies and evaluations.</p></div><div class="framework-type"><strong>Applied projects</strong><p>AI tools, applications and decision-support systems.</p></div></div><p class="framework-note">Either pillar can include research, applied development, or both.</p></div>
</section>
```

## Aligned with Europe's Research Priorities

The Lab's interests intersect with European-funded research and initiatives in adaptive regulation, human-AI collaboration, AI-supported policymaking, and AI-enabled science.

::: {.initiative-grid}

::: {.initiative-card}
<div class="initiative-type">MSCA DOCTORAL NETWORK</div>

### [REGULAIRE ↗](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101312218)

How can regulation adapt and learn as technologies evolve?
:::

::: {.initiative-card}
<div class="initiative-type">MSCA DOCTORAL NETWORK</div>

### [EMANAIRE ↗](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101311637)

How does AI change human agency, work, and decisions?
:::

::: {.initiative-card}
<div class="initiative-type">HORIZON EUROPE PROJECT</div>

### [AI4POL ↗](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101177455)

How can AI help regulators and policymakers govern technology?
:::

::: {.initiative-card}
<div class="initiative-type">EUROPEAN AI IN SCIENCE INITIATIVE</div>

### [RAISE ↗](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/strategy/strategy-research-and-innovation/our-digital-future/european-ai-science-strategy/raise-resource-ai-science-europe_en)

How can AI accelerate research and scientific discovery?
:::
